components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4a4e7a; color: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; height: 36px; font-family: Aspekta, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.22), 0 6px 16px rgba(74,78,122,0.22), -3px -3px 10px rgba(255,255,255,0.68); transition: filter 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.26), 0 8px 20px rgba(74,78,122,0.28), -4px -4px 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.68); filter: brightness(1.04); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow: inset 3px 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.24), inset -2px -2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.12); transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4a4e7a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Raised surface button for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fafafa; color: #18191b; padding: 8px 16px; height: 36px; font-family: Aspekta, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 450; border: 1px solid #efefeb; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.58), 5px 5px 13px rgba(105,112,116,0.13), -4px -4px 10px rgba(255,255,255,0.68); transition: color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.58), 6px 6px 15px rgba(105,112,116,0.13), -4px -4px 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.68); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { box-shadow: inset 3px 3px 7px rgba(105,112,116,0.13), inset -2px -2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.68); transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4a4e7a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chat Composer
components.description: Recessed input well with inset neumorphic shadow. Focus adds ring glow.
components.css: .ds-composer { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #f3f3f5; border-radius: 16px; padding: 6px; box-shadow: inset 3px 3px 7px rgba(105,112,116,0.13), inset -2px -2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.68); transition: box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-composer:focus-within { box-shadow: inset 3px 3px 7px rgba(105,112,116,0.13), inset -2px -2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.68), 0 0 0 2px rgba(74,78,122,0.28); } .ds-composer input { background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; flex: 1; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: Aspekta, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #18191b; } .ds-composer input::placeholder { color: #5a6066; } .ds-send { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 12px; background: #4a4e7a; color: #fff; border: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.22), 0 4px 14px rgba(74,78,122,0.25); transition: transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-send:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-send:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.95); }

narrative.overview:
Reogent's interface is a precision instrument where every surface is permanently sculpted — softly dimensional at rest, not just on interaction. The system reads as a single continuous material shaped into different forms for different functions: raised for actions, recessed for input, flat for content. There is no decoration, no illustration, no ornament. The quality lives entirely in the precision of shadow, spacing, and typographic hierarchy.

This is modern neumorphism that learned from the excesses of 2020: shadows are tight and crisp rather than bloomy, offsets are close to the surface rather than dramatic, and the light source is unwavering. Controls have permanent gentle dimension — you can see what is pressable, what is a well, what is content, without touching anything. The interface teaches itself through physical metaphor.

The overall character is authoritative and refined — closer to a precision optical instrument than a friendly app. It earns trust through obsessive consistency: every radius, every shadow recipe, every spacing value repeats from a finite set. Nothing is approximate. Nothing is custom. The system is small and the application of it is rigorous.
keyCharacteristics: Always softly sculpted — permanent gentle dimension on every surface, not depth-on-hover
Tight and crisp shadows — close offsets (4–6px), controlled blur (10–16px), no bloom
Single-material coherence — every element looks molded from the same substance
Precision over expression — alignment, spacing, and consistency are the aesthetic
Muted indigo accent — distinctive but restrained, never dominant
Content-forward — neumorphic frame never competes with chat messages or map data

rules.name: The Muted-for-AA Rule
rules.body: All subdued text uses --muted (#5a6066). Never --outline or --outline-variant for text — they fail WCAG AA on light surfaces.

rules.name: The Indigo Scarcity Rule
rules.body: The primary indigo appears only on interactive elements and active states. Never for decorative purposes, background fills, or large surfaces. Its presence always means actionable or current.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Bold Rule
rules.body: Emphasis uses weight 500–550. Bold (700+) never appears in the interface. Maximum weight is 600 for landing display only.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Data Rule
rules.body: Structured identifiers (course codes, times, building codes, distances, amounts) render in Commit Mono. Data has a different texture than prose.

rules.name: The 14px-Base Rule
rules.body: Body text is 0.875rem (14px). This is an information-dense tool, not a reading experience. Tighter base allows more content visible without scrolling.

rules.name: The Dual-Tier Rule
rules.body: Tier 1 (Tailwind shadow-* utilities) for one-off depth. Tier 2 (.neu-* classes) for composed surfaces. Never mix on the same element.

rules.name: The Light-Source Rule
rules.body: Light source is always upper-left. Every shadow falls bottom-right, every highlight top-left. Every .neu-* class has inset 0 1px 0 var(--neu-edge). No exceptions.

rules.name: The Permanent-Dimension Rule
rules.body: Neumorphic surfaces have depth at rest. Hover/active change the recipe (expand or invert), but depth never starts at zero. The interface is always gently sculpted.

dos: Do apply .neu-panel / .neu-raised / .neu-inset for composed surfaces — they carry the full edge-highlight + multi-shadow recipe.
Do use --muted (#5a6066) for all subdued text. Never --outline or --outline-variant for text.
Do use --neu-ease (cubic-bezier 0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for all panel/layout animations at 250–420ms.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion — all animations collapse to 0.01ms, reveals show immediately.
Do use [data-theme="dark"] for theme switching — never prefers-color-scheme media query.
Do maintain permanent gentle dimension on all surfaces at all times.
Do use asymmetric bubble radii to indicate message direction without visible tails.
donts: Don't mix Tier 1 (shadow-* utilities) and Tier 2 (.neu-* classes) on the same element.
Don't add border to elements with .neu-* or .glass-neu-* classes. Exception: .neu-button has designed 1px border-subtle.
Don't use pure black in any shadow — warm gray in light mode, deep neutral in dark mode only.
Don't apply backdrop-filter outside the four .glass-neu-* classes. Glass is architectural, never decorative.
Don't animate shadow values directly — animate transform and switch classes via state.
Don't apply neumorphic depth to text content — depth frames containers, content stays flat.
Don't use font-weight 700+ anywhere. Maximum is 600 (landing display + markdown strong).
Don't use primary indigo for backgrounds, decoration, or large surfaces. It means interactive only.
Don't create new shadow recipes. Use existing three (panel, raised, inset) or five elevation utilities.
